messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 5xx on POST /v1/embeddings across eu-central-1. Auto-detected by routing-guard. Paging @sarah (oncall) and @priya (sre). Please ack and start triage.

sarah (oncall): ack — i'm on it. dashboards show spike starting 2112223300, sustained ~150rps -> 50% errors.

tom (eng-runtime): quick grep of runtime logs shows: `router.go:482 chooseVersion alias=acct-42-embeds chosen=chat-alpha-v3 reason=pinned_version` followed by `handler: incompatible_request_type: embedding not supported by model` — looks like embedding traffic being routed to a chat/instruct variant.

priya (sre): can we find who applied that pin? audit log?

tom (eng-runtime): audit: `user=deploy-bot action=pin alias=acct-42-embeds target=chat-alpha-v3 ts=2112223299` — it's an automated pin from the morning rollout job. rollout bot probably selected a latest version without capability check.

emily (support): impacted customers: data-labs (prod ingest jobs failing), retail-ai (batch embeddings delayed). Tickets created: #5120, #5127. reported errors: "handler not found" and 500s.

sarah (oncall): mitigation plan: (A) remove the pinned version so alias falls back to correct embed default, (B) set short override to explicitly route request.type==embed to embed-runtime while we validate, (C) notify customers. prefer A then B.

tom (eng-runtime): ready to unpin. command: ```controlplane pin remove --alias acct-42-embeds --reason "rollback bad automated pin"``` then ```controlplane route-override create --expr "req.metadata.type=='embedding'" --target embed-runtime --ttl 900```

ops-bot: queued command: `pin remove acct-42-embeds` by tom at 2112223351.

tom (eng-runtime): executing unpin now.

ops-bot: command success: `pin remove acct-42-embeds` (txn id 0xbe7a).

tom (eng-runtime): override created, ttl 900s. override id=ovr_7b2. forcing embed traffic to embed-runtime.

priya (sre): watching metrics — 60s after override error rate down from 50% -> 4%. latency improving. :white_check_mark:

emily (support): notified affected customers with status update and workaround; some re-runs already succeeded.

ethan (devex): root cause hypothesis: rollout automation picks most recent model version for aliases without checking model "capabilities" field. the pin UI/automation lacks server-side validation to reject incompatible pairs (eg. alias intended for embeddings pinned to chat-only model). we should add guardrails: (1) server-side validation during pin operations, (2) rollout job should prefer same-capability variants, (3) an alert for alias->variant capability mismatch.

tom (eng-runtime): agree. i'll open a control-plane PR to validate capability compatibility and also add an immediate instrumented alert that fires if an alias maps to a variant that doesn't declare required capabilities. i'll drop a link to the PR here.

sarah (oncall): handoff: i'll wrap up and hand monitoring to @priya for 2hr watch. priya, please leave the override in place until we get deploy/PR merged or we confirm stability for 2 hours.

priya (sre): ack. monitoring window started. will escalate if errors >5% p10 over 5m.

ops-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity set to Sev2.

emily (support): impact summary for postmortem: timeframe 2112223300-2112223351; total failed requests ~9.8k; customers: data-labs (priority), retail-ai (mid). all affected parties updated.

ethan (devex): action items: (1) hide incompatible variant options in pin UI (2) add server-side pin validation (3) add rollout job check to prefer matching-capability variants (4) instrument alias->variant mismatch alert. assigning to tom/ethan/priya.

tom (eng-runtime): created incident doc and PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/incidents/2112223344 (will attach logs + route traces).

sarah (oncall): good work team. final note: avoid automated global pins during active rollouts without capability checks. closing live thread; leave follow-up tasks in incident board. :thumbsup:
